Whitepaper

Introduction

$BRASS is a community-first memecoin built from absolute zero. No paid influencers. No artificial hype. Organic growth only.

The Problem

Most Pump.fun launches rely on bot activity, paid promotion, and surprise launches. Early groups often buy, promote, and exit.

The Approach

1 real person is worth more than 100 bots. Telegram is the primary coordination channel. Single wallet. No hidden bundles. Launch details are posted 24 hours in advance.

Allocation

1 SOL at launch is shared with the team, active members, and development (if the launch succeeds). A second SOL is used to buy $BRASS after launch. Those tokens are allocated to community airdrops and giveaways.

NFT Plan

10,000 NFTs minted at 0.01 SOL each, generating 100 SOL. 25 SOL is allocated to development. 75 SOL is allocated to a 500x gold tier DEX boost and DexScanner verification. No paid promoters. Community support comes first.
